verses.sloka: त्वरमणः ततो गत्वा जनस्थानात् अकंपनः ।प्रविश्य लंकाम् वेगेन रावणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-१॥
verses.transliteration: tvaramaṇaḥ tato gatvā janasthānāt akaṁpanaḥ ।praviśya laṁkām vegena rāvaṇam vākyam abravīt ॥3-31-1॥

translations.english: Quickly did Akampana leave Janasthana, and quickly he entered Lanka. He said to Ravana:
translations.hindi: म (क ९ त्रिशः सगः -"%-- छ ® ७. ~ च भित्त्वा तु तां गदां बाणे राघवो धर्मवत्सलः । स्मयमानः! खर वाक्य संरब्धरमिदमब्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: जनस्थान स्थिता राजन् रक्षसा बहवो हताः ।खरः च निहतः संख्ये क्थम्चित् अहम् आगतः ॥३-३१-२॥
verses.transliteration: janasthāna sthitā rājan rakṣasā bahavo hatāḥ ।kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṁkhye kthamcit aham āgataḥ ॥3-31-2॥

translations.english: O king many demons dwelling at Janasthana including Khara have been killed. I manged to escape with much difficulty.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरकत लोचनः ।अकंपनम् उवाच इदम् निर्दहन् इव तेजसा ॥३-३१-३॥
verses.transliteration: evam ukto daśagrīvaḥ kruddhaḥ saṁrakata locanaḥ ।akaṁpanam uvāca idam nirdahan iva tejasā ॥3-31-3॥

translations.english: When Akampana thus reported to the tenheaded Ravana, his eyes reddened with anger. He spoke to Akampana as if he was burning him with his eyes :
translations.hindi: बढ़ बढ़ कर बातें मारने बाले, तुझ ढीठ की, शात्रुनाशिनी यह्‌ गदा, मेरे बाणों से चूर हो, प्रथिवी पर पड़ी है

verses.sloka: केन भीमम् जनस्थानम् हतम् मम परासुना ।को हि सर्वेषु लोकेषु गतिम् न अधिगमिष्यति ॥३-३१-४॥
verses.transliteration: kena bhīmam janasthānam hatam mama parāsunā ।ko hi sarveṣu lokeṣu gatim na adhigamiṣyati ॥3-31-4॥

translations.english: He who has destroyed my beautiful Janasthana is sure to die. His life is under the control of others (his enemies). Where can he be(alive) in all the worlds?
translations.hindi: तूने जो कहा था कि, “में मरे हुए राक्षसों की विधवाओं अर अनाथ बच्चों के आँसू पोंछूगा” खो तेरी बह बात भी झूठी हो गई

verses.sloka: न हि मे विप्रियम् कृता शक्यम् मघवता सुखम् ।प्रप्तुम् वैश्रवणेन अपि न यमेन च विष्णुना ॥३-३१-५॥
verses.transliteration: na hi me vipriyam kṛtā śakyam maghavatā sukham ।praptum vaiśravaṇena api na yamena ca viṣṇunā ॥3-31-5॥

translations.english: One who has caused displeasure to me cannot be happy, be it Indra or Kubera, or Yama or even Visnu.

verses.sloka: कालस्य च अपि अहम् कलो दहेयम् अपि पावकम् ।मृत्युम् मरण धर्मेण संयोजयितुम् उत्सहे ॥३-३१-६॥
verses.transliteration: kālasya ca api aham kalo daheyam api pāvakam ।mṛtyum maraṇa dharmeṇa saṁyojayitum utsahe ॥3-31-6॥

translations.english: I am the destroyer of the destroyer (Yama). I can burn even that which burns (fire). I can infuse Death with the characteristics of death itself.
translations.hindi: मेरे बाणों से बिदारित हो, जव. तेरा सिर कट जायगा, तब तेरे गले के काग सहित रक्त को एथिवी आज पान करेगी

verses.sloka: वातस्य तरसा वेगम् निहन्तुम् अपि च उत्सहे ।दहेयम् अपि संक्रुद्धः तेजसा आदित्य पावकौ ॥३-३१-७॥
verses.transliteration: vātasya tarasā vegam nihantum api ca utsahe ।daheyam api saṁkruddhaḥ tejasā āditya pāvakau ॥3-31-7॥

translations.english: If angry, I can burn the Sun and even fire with my radiance. I can arrest the speed of the wind instantly with my effort.
translations.hindi: लि अभी तू धूल धूसरित हो और अपनी दोनों भुजाओं को ला कर, भूमि को बैसे ही आलिज्ञन किए हुए सोबेगा, जैसे “कं कामी पुरुष किसी ढुलेभ स्त्री को आलिङ्गन कर के सोता

verses.sloka: तथा क्रुद्धम् दशग्रीवम् कृतांजलिः अकंपनः ।भयात् संदिग्धया वचा रावणम् याचते अभयम् ॥३-३१-८॥
verses.transliteration: tathā kruddham daśagrīvam kṛtāṁjaliḥ akaṁpanaḥ ।bhayāt saṁdigdhayā vacā rāvaṇam yācate abhayam ॥3-31-8॥

translations.english: Akampana, out of fear, implored the inflamed Ravana with folded hands and faltering voice to spare him.
translations.hindi: अरे राक्षसाधम ! जव तू दीघे निद्रा में सो जायगा, ( अर्थात्‌ मर जायगा ) तब अरक्षित ऋषियों के लिए यह दरडकवन सुख से रहने योग्य स्थान हो जायगा

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवो अभयम् तस्मै प्रददौ रक्षसाम् वरः ।स विस्रब्धो अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् असंदिग्धम् अकंपनः ॥३-३१-९॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvo abhayam tasmai pradadau rakṣasām varaḥ ।sa visrabdho abravīt vākyam asaṁdigdham akaṁpanaḥ ॥3-31-9॥

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana, lord of the demons, assured safety to Akampana, who gratefully said these words without hesitation:
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार गरुड़ जी ने अस्त को हुरा था, उसी प्रकार सें भी नीच, ओछे स्वभाव वाले, झूठा व्यवहार करने वाले, तु राक्षस के प्राण ( अभी ) हरता हूँ

verses.sloka: पुत्रो दशरथः ते सिंह संहननो युवा ।रामो नाम महास्कंधो वृत्त आयत महाभुजः ॥३-३१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: putro daśarathaḥ te siṁha saṁhanano yuvā ।rāmo nāma mahāskaṁdho vṛtta āyata mahābhujaḥ ॥3-31-10॥

translations.english: Dasaratha has a young son, by name, Rama. He has a body like a lion's. He has strong, round arms and his shoulders resemble those of a bull.
translations.hindi: दूसरे को भयभीत करने वाली राक्षसियाँ, अपने सम्बन्धियों के मारे जाने के कारण, दीनभाव से रोती हुई और भयभीत हो, आज यहाँ से भाग जायगी

verses.sloka: श्यामः पृथुयशाः श्रीमान् अतुल्य बल विक्रमः ।हतः तेन जनस्थाने खरः च सह दूषणः ॥३-३१-११॥
verses.transliteration: śyāmaḥ pṛthuyaśāḥ śrīmān atulya bala vikramaḥ ।hataḥ tena janasthāne kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ ॥3-31-11॥

translations.english: He is a hero of great fame and unequal prowess. He has destroyed your Janasthana and also Khara along with Dusana.
translations.hindi: जिन ६ राक्षसियों का तुम जैसा दुराचारी पति हे, वे अपने कुल, के अनुरूप ढुराचारिणी राक्षसियाँ, आज शोकरस का आस्वादन कर, हीनवीर्यं हो जायँगी । अर्थात्‌ अब वे उपद्रव न करेंगी

verses.sloka: अकंपन वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिप ।नागेन्द्र इव निःश्वस्य इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: akaṁpana vacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipa ।nāgendra iva niḥśvasya idam vacanam abravīt ॥3-31-12॥

translations.english: Having heard Akampana's words, Ravana, the lord of demons, sighed heavily like the king of serpents and said these words:
translations.hindi: रे निष्ठुर ! रे नीच ! रे छुद्र बुद्धि वाले! रे ब्राह्मणों को सदा सताने वाले! तुक जैसा लोगों के डर ही से मुनिलोग निःशङ्क हो हवन नहीं करने पाते

verses.sloka: स सुरेन्द्रेण संयुक्तो रामः सर्व अमरैः सह ।उपयातो जनस्थानम् ब्रूहि कच्चित् अकंपन ॥३-३१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sa surendreṇa saṁyukto rāmaḥ sarva amaraiḥ saha ।upayāto janasthānam brūhi kaccit akaṁpana ॥3-31-13॥

translations.english: Did Rama come to Janasthana with Indra and the gods ? O Akampana speak.
translations.hindi: जब कुपित हो श्रीराम ने खर से ऐसे वचन कहे; तब खर भी ` क्रोध में भर, उच्चस्वर से श्रीराम को गालियाँ देता ढुबादिक हुआ बोला

verses.sloka: रावणस्य पुनर् वाक्यम् निशम्य तद् अकंपनः ।आचचक्षे बलम् तस्य विक्रमम् च महात्मनः ॥३-३१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya punar vākyam niśamya tad akaṁpanaḥ ।ācacakṣe balam tasya vikramam ca mahātmanaḥ ॥3-31-14॥

translations.english: Hearing Ravana's words, Akampana continued telling about great Rama's strength and his exploits in war.

verses.sloka: रामो नाम महातेजाः श्रेष्टः सर्व धनुष्मताम् ।दिव्य अस्त्र गुण संपन्नः परम्धर्म गतो युधि ॥३-३१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: rāmo nāma mahātejāḥ śreṣṭaḥ sarva dhanuṣmatām ।divya astra guṇa saṁpannaḥ paramdharma gato yudhi ॥3-31-15॥

translations.english: Rama is his name. He looks very radiant. He is the best among the archers. Owner of divine weapons, he is comparable to Indra in war.
translations.hindi: निश्चय ही तू बड़ा घमंडी है। इसीसे त भय रहने पर भी निर्भयसा जान पड़ता है। तेरी मृत्यु निकट हे । इसीसे त बोलंते ससय यह नहा समझ सकता कि, क्या कहना चाहिए और कया | i. ती १ तमेवमभिसंरब्धमू--एवंबचोत्र बाणम्‌ । (शि०) २ `हढं-निश्चितं। (२०) रे आवलिप्तोति--गवितोति ( गो० ) त्रशः सग: २२६ कालपाशपरिक्षिप्घा भवन्ति पुरुपा हि ये । कार्याकायं न जानन्ति ते निरस्तपडिन्द्रियाः

verses.sloka: तस्य अनुरूपो बलब्वान् रक्ताक्षो दुन्दुभि स्वनः ।कनीयान् लक्ष्मणो भ्राता राका शशि निभ आननः ॥३-३१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tasya anurūpo balabvān raktākṣo dundubhi svanaḥ ।kanīyān lakṣmaṇo bhrātā rākā śaśi nibha ānanaḥ ॥3-31-16॥

translations.english: He is strong with bright red eyes. He has a deep voice with the resonance of a drum. His face is like the moon. Lakshmana, his younger brother, is similar to him in appearance.

verses.sloka: स तेन सह संयुक्तः पावकेन अनिलो यथा ।श्रीमान् राज वरः तेन जनस्थानम् निपातितम् ॥३-३१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sa tena saha saṁyuktaḥ pāvakena anilo yathā ।śrīmān rāja varaḥ tena janasthānam nipātitam ॥3-31-17॥

translations.english: Rama is prosperous. He is the best among kings. Lakshmana with him is like wind with fire. Rama has pulled down Janasthana.

verses.sloka: न एव देवा महत्मनो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा ।शरा रामेण तु उत्सृष्टा रुक्मपुंखाः पतत्रिणः ॥३-३१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: na eva devā mahatmano na atra kāryā vicāraṇā ।śarā rāmeṇa tu utsṛṣṭā rukmapuṁkhāḥ patatriṇaḥ ॥3-31-18॥

translations.english: Indeed, they are great men. No god came there (to lend him a hand). There is no need to investigate further about it. The goldenfeathered arrows released by Rama turned into fivehooded serpents and consumed the demons.
translations.hindi: ओर घोर गर्जना कर, दोनों सुजाओं से उस वृक्ष को, श्रीराम जी को लक्ष्य कर और यह कह; कर कि, “बस, अब तू मारा गया? फेंका

verses.sloka: सर्पाः पंचानना भूत्वा भक्षयन्ति स्म राक्षसान् ।येन येन च गच्छन्ति राक्षसा भय कर्शिताः ॥३-३१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sarpāḥ paṁcānanā bhūtvā bhakṣayanti sma rākṣasān ।yena yena ca gacchanti rākṣasā bhaya karśitāḥ ॥3-31-19॥

translations.english: Wherever the demons went they, gripped by fear, only saw Rama in front. O sinless sire In this manner your Janasthana was destroyed by him.

verses.sloka: तेन तेन स्म पश्यन्ति रामम् एव अग्रतः स्थितम् ।इत्थम् विनाशितम् जनस्थानम् तेन तव अनघ ॥३-३१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tena tena sma paśyanti rāmam eva agrataḥ sthitam ।ittham vināśitam janasthānam tena tava anagha ॥3-31-20॥

translations.english: Wherever the demons went they, gripped by fear, only saw Rama in front. O sinless sire In this manner your Janasthana was destroyed by him.
translations.hindi: उस समय मारे क्रोध के श्रीराम जी का शरीर पसीने से तर ओर उनके नेत्र खून की तरह लाल हो गए । उन्होंने एक हजार बाण खर के मारे

verses.sloka: अकंपन अचः श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।गमिष्यामि जनस्थनम् रामम् हन्तुम् स लक्ष्मणम् ॥३-३१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: akaṁpana acaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo vākyam abravīt ।gamiṣyāmi janasthanam rāmam hantum sa lakṣmaṇam ॥3-31-21॥

translations.english: Hearing Akampana's words, Ravana said, I will go to Janasthana and kill Rama along with Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: उन बाणों के घावों में से फेनयुक्त रक्त की धारें उसी प्रकार बहने लगीं, जिस प्रकार पहाड़ी भरनों से पानी की धारे बहती हैं.

verses.sloka: अथ एवम् उक्ते वचने प्रोवाच इदम् अकंपनः ।श्रुणु राजन् यथा वृत्तम् रामस्य बल पौरुषम् ॥३-३१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: atha evam ukte vacane provāca idam akaṁpanaḥ ।śruṇu rājan yathā vṛttam rāmasya bala pauruṣam ॥3-31-22॥

translations.english: Thus said by Ravana, Akampana responded, I will tell you what happened there. O king listen to the strength and valour of Rama.
translations.hindi: श्रीराम जी ने खर, को उस युद्ध में, बाणों के आघात से व्याकुल कर दिआ। तब तो वह (अपने शरीर से निकलते हुए) रक्त की गन्ध से मतवाला हो, बढे वेग से श्रीराम को ओर झपटा

verses.sloka: असाध्यः कुपितो रामो विक्रमेण महायशाः ।आप गायाः तु पूर्णाया वेगम् परिहरेत् शरैः ॥३-३१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: asādhyaḥ kupito rāmo vikrameṇa mahāyaśāḥ ।āpa gāyāḥ tu pūrṇāyā vegam pariharet śaraiḥ ॥3-31-23॥

translations.english: Rama is of great fame. When outraged, he is irrepressible. He can arrest with his arrows even the speed of a river (in spate).
translations.hindi: बाणान्तरात्‌--आणक्षतविवरातू । ( गोऽ ) २ फेनिलं--फेनवत । ( गो० ) ३ परिखवः--प्रवाह: | (गो०) ४ संरब्धं-सं भ्रान्तं । (तोः ) ` ७ प्रतिपदं--अज्ज मोचनप्रतिकूलं । ( गोऽ ) खर को, क्रद्ध और खून में डूबा हुआ अपनी ओर आते देख, और उस पर अस्त्र छोड़ने की घात न पा, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी तुरन्त कुछ पीछे हट गए

verses.sloka: स तारा ग्रह नक्षत्रम् नभः च अपि अवसादयेत् ।असौ रामः तु सीदन्तीम् श्रीमान् अभ्युद्धरेत् महीम् ॥३-३१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tārā graha nakṣatram nabhaḥ ca api avasādayet ।asau rāmaḥ tu sīdantīm śrīmān abhyuddharet mahīm ॥3-31-24॥

translations.english: Powerful Rama can pull down the sky along with the planets and stars. He can lift the drowning earth from the depth of the sea.
translations.hindi: यह बाण अगस्त्य जी को धीमान्‌ इन्द्र ने दिआ था, ( और झगस्त्य से श्रीराम जी को मिला था, ) धर्मात्मा श्रीराम जी ने वही बाण धनुष पर रख, खर के ऊपर छोड़ा

verses.sloka: भित्वा वेलाम् समुद्रस्य लोकान् आप्लावयेत् विभुः ।वेगम् वा अपि समुद्रस्य वाअयुम् वा विधमेत् शरैः ॥३-३१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: bhitvā velām samudrasya lokān āplāvayet vibhuḥ ।vegam vā api samudrasya vāayum vā vidhamet śaraiḥ ॥3-31-25॥

translations.english: He is so very powerful that he can drown the earth by breaking the boundary of the sea. He can arrest the speed of the sea or of the wind with his arrows.

verses.sloka: संहृत्य वा पुनर् लोकान् विक्रमेण महायशाः ।शकतः श्रेष्ठः स पुरुषः स्रष्टुम् पुनर् अपि प्रजाः ॥३-३१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: saṁhṛtya vā punar lokān vikrameṇa mahāyaśāḥ ।śakataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sraṣṭum punar api prajāḥ ॥3-31-26॥

translations.english: He is a tiger among men. He is so powerful that he can destroy the world and recreate the creatures once again by his valour.
translations.hindi: श्रीराम जी ने धलुप को तान कर जब वाण छोड़ा, तब वह बाण बज्र के समान महानाद करता हुआ खर की छाती में जा कर लगा

verses.sloka: न हि रामो दशग्रीव शक्यो जेतुम् रणे त्वया ।रक्षसाम् वा अपि लोकेन स्वर्गः पाप जनैः इव ॥३-३१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: na hi rāmo daśagrīva śakyo jetum raṇe tvayā ।rakṣasām vā api lokena svargaḥ pāpa janaiḥ iva ॥3-31-27॥

translations.english: O tenheaded one, just as it is not possible for sinners to attain heaven it is not possible for you or for the entire world of demons to win him in war
translations.hindi: है स पपात खरो भूमौ दहयमानः शराग्निना। रद्रेणेव विनिर्दग्धः श्वेतारणये यथान्तकः

verses.sloka: न तम् वध्यम् अहम् मन्ये सर्वैः देव असुरैः अपि ।अयम् अस्य वध उपाय तत् एकमनाः शृउणु ॥३-३१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: na tam vadhyam aham manye sarvaiḥ deva asuraiḥ api ।ayam asya vadha upāya tat ekamanāḥ śṛuṇu ॥3-31-28॥

translations.english: I do not think it is possible for gods and demons together to kill him, yet there is a way for his destruction. You may listen to me with single mindedattention:

verses.sloka: भार्या तस्य उत्तमा लोके सीता नाम सुमध्यमा ।श्यामा सम विभक्त अंगी स्त्री रत्नम् रत्न बूषिता ॥३-३१-२९॥
verses.transliteration: bhāryā tasya uttamā loke sītā nāma sumadhyamā ।śyāmā sama vibhakta aṁgī strī ratnam ratna būṣitā ॥3-31-29॥

translations.english: Rama has a wife in this world, by name, Sita, who is beautiful, has a slender waist and a wellformed body. Adorned with gems, she is a jewel among women,

verses.sloka: न एव देवी न गन्धर्वी न अप्सरा न च पन्नगी ।तुल्या सीमन्तिनी तस्या मानुषी तु कुतो भवेत् ॥३-३१-३०॥
verses.transliteration: na eva devī na gandharvī na apsarā na ca pannagī ।tulyā sīmantinī tasyā mānuṣī tu kuto bhavet ॥3-31-30॥

translations.english: She has no equal among goddesses nor among gandharvis nor apasaras nor among demonesses. How can there be a peer of her among human beings ?

verses.sloka: तस्य अपहर भार्याम् त्वम् तम् प्रमथ्य महावने ।सीताया रहितो रामो न च एव हि भविष्यति ॥३-३१-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya apahara bhāryām tvam tam pramathya mahāvane ।sītāyā rahito rāmo na ca eva hi bhaviṣyati ॥3-31-31॥

translations.english: Abduct Rama's wife by force in that great forest and bereft of Sita, he will give up his life.
translations.hindi: और इन ऋरकर्मा पापी राक्षसों के वध के लिए ही यत्नपूर्वेक महर्षिगण तुमको यहाँ लाए थे

verses.sloka: अरोचयत् तद् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः ।चिंतयित्वा महाबाहुः अकंपनम् उवाच ॥३-३१-३२॥
verses.transliteration: arocayat tad vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।ciṁtayitvā mahābāhuḥ akaṁpanam uvāca ॥3-31-32॥

translations.english: Ravana, the strongarmed king of demons, relished the words of Akampana and pondering over the matter, said to him :

verses.sloka: बाढम् कल्यम् गमिष्यामि हि एकः सारथिना सह ।आनेष्यामि च वैदेहीम् इमाम् हृष्टो महा पुरीम् ॥३-३१-३३॥
verses.transliteration: bāḍham kalyam gamiṣyāmi hi ekaḥ sārathinā saha ।āneṣyāmi ca vaidehīm imām hṛṣṭo mahā purīm ॥3-31-33॥

translations.english: Yes, early in the morning I will go alone gladly with the charioteer and bring Vaidehi here to this great city.
translations.hindi: इतने ही में देवता लोग चारणों को साथ लिए हुए आए और उन लोगों ने नगाड़े बजा कर चारों ओर फूलों की वर्षा की

verses.sloka: तत् एवम् उक्त्वा प्रययौ खर युक्तेन रावणः ।रथेन आदित्य वर्णेन दिशः सर्वाः प्रकाशयन् ॥३-३१-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tat evam uktvā prayayau khara yuktena rāvaṇaḥ ।rathena āditya varṇena diśaḥ sarvāḥ prakāśayan ॥3-31-34॥

translations.english: Having said so, Ravana got on a chariot yoked with donkeys. It had the colour of the Sun. It illuminated all directions. Ravana left.
translations.hindi: फिर, हर्षित हो और श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर पुष्यों की बृष्टि कर, वे विस्मित हुए कि, तीन ही घड़ी में अपने पेने बाणों से

verses.sloka: स रथो राक्षस इंद्रस्य नक्षत्र पथगो महान् ।चंचूर्यमानः शुशुभे जलदे चंद्रमा इव ॥३-३१-३५॥
verses.transliteration: sa ratho rākṣasa iṁdrasya nakṣatra pathago mahān ।caṁcūryamānaḥ śuśubhe jalade caṁdramā iva ॥3-31-35॥

translations.english: The great chariot of the demon king (Ravana) flying in the sky shone like the Moon in the cloud.
translations.hindi: ढाई घड़े का एक घंटा होता है--्रतः, लगभग सवा घंटे में ] चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्‌ । ख रदूषणमुख्यानां निहतानि महावेह

verses.sloka: स दूरे च आश्रमम् गत्वा ताटकेयम् उपागतम् ।मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा भक्ष्य भोज्यैः अमानुषैः ॥३-३१-३६॥
verses.transliteration: sa dūre ca āśramam gatvā tāṭakeyam upāgatam ।mārīcena arcito rājā bhakṣya bhojyaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ ॥3-31-36॥

translations.english: Ravana reached the hermitage of Maricha and met him who was the son of Tataka. The demon king was treated with food that can be chewed and food that can be eaten.
translations.hindi: लप जी से सम्मानित हो, वीरबर श्रीमराचन्द्र जी ने आश्रम में प्रवेश किआ । शत्रुहन्ता एवं महर्षियों को आनन्द देने “वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को देख,

verses.sloka: तम् स्वयम् पूजयित्वा तु आसनेन उदकेन च ।अर्थ उपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tam svayam pūjayitvā tu āsanena udakena ca ।artha upahitayā vācā mārīco vākyam abravīt ॥3-31-37॥

translations.english: Maricha personally offered Ravana a seat. He offered him water and paid him obeisance. Making meaningful enquiries he said in appropriate words :
translations.hindi: यह कह कर, द सब देवता जहाँ से आए थे, वहाँ लोट कर चले गए। इतने में शूरवीर लक्ष्मण, सीता जी को साथ लिए हुए

verses.sloka: कश्चित् सुकुशलम् राजन् लोकानाम् राक्षसाधिप ।आशंके न अथ जाने त्वम् यतः तूर्णम् उपागतम् ॥३-३१-३८॥
verses.transliteration: kaścit sukuśalam rājan lokānām rākṣasādhipa ।āśaṁke na atha jāne tvam yataḥ tūrṇam upāgatam ॥3-31-38॥

translations.english: O lord of demons O king hope every one is fine in the world of demons. O lord, (though) your sudden arrival puts me in doubt (about everything going right).

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावण ।ततः पश्चात् इदम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् वाक्य कोविदः ॥३-३१-३९॥
verses.transliteration: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa ।tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ ॥3-31-39॥

translations.english: Having thus been asked by Maricha, glorious Ravana, who was eloquent in speech, spoke to him :

verses.sloka: आरक्षो मे हतः तात रामेण अक्लिष्ट कारिणा ।जनस्थानम् अवध्यम् तत् सर्वम् युधि निपातितम् ॥३-३१-४०॥
verses.transliteration: ārakṣo me hataḥ tāta rāmeṇa akliṣṭa kāriṇā ।janasthānam avadhyam tat sarvam yudhi nipātitam ॥3-31-40॥

translations.english: O dear, Rama who is capable of doing difficult deeds has killed my sentinels. The indestructible Janasthana has been routed in war. Could you help me in abudcting his wife ? (That is the only way to bring him to his knees).
translations.hindi: अन्तरे--भवसरे। (यो) रस 7 तर (योऽ) २ सुखी-- ख रः इ ( 0 ) ८ रामपराक्रमदशनजन्यसन्तोष- जनकनन्दिनी सीता जो प्रसन्न हुई और राक्षसों को मरा हुआ देख, जानकी जी ने परभ सुख माना । फिर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को विथा रहित अथवा निरापद देख, जानकी जी सन्तुष्ट हुई

verses.sloka: तस्य मे कुरु साचिव्यम् तस्य भार्य अपहरणे ।राक्षसेन्द्र वचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३१-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya me kuru sācivyam tasya bhārya apaharaṇe ।rākṣasendra vacaḥ śrutvā mārīco vākyam abravīt ॥3-31-41॥

translations.english: Having heard Ravana ,the king of demons, Maricha said these words: O king, who is that enemy of yours who, in the guise of a friend, has told you about Sita? Though obliged by you, who is he that is not happy with you, O tiger among demons?

verses.sloka: आख्याता केन वा सीता मित्र रूपेण शत्रुणा ।त्वया राक्षस शार्दूल को न नंदति नंदितः ॥३-३१-४२॥
verses.transliteration: ākhyātā kena vā sītā mitra rūpeṇa śatruṇā ।tvayā rākṣasa śārdūla ko na naṁdati naṁditaḥ ॥3-31-42॥

translations.english: Having heard Ravana ,the king of demons, Maricha said these words: O king, who is that enemy of yours who, in the guise of a friend, has told you about Sita? Though obliged by you, who is he that is not happy with you, O tiger among demons?

verses.sloka: सीताम् इह आनस्व इति को ब्रवीति ब्रवीहि मे ।रक्षो लोकस्य सर्वस्य कः शृंगम् च्छेत्तुम् इच्छति ॥३-३१-४३॥
verses.transliteration: sītām iha ānasva iti ko bravīti bravīhi me ।rakṣo lokasya sarvasya kaḥ śṛṁgam cchettum icchati ॥3-31-43॥

translations.english: Tell me who asked you to bring Sita ? Who wishes to demolish the peak of the entire clan of demons ?

verses.sloka: प्रोत्साहयति यः च त्वम् स च शत्रुः असंशयम् ।आशी मुखात् दंष्ट्राम् उद्धर्तुम् च इच्छति त्वया ॥३-३१-४४॥
verses.transliteration: protsāhayati yaḥ ca tvam sa ca śatruḥ asaṁśayam ।āśī mukhāt daṁṣṭrām uddhartum ca icchati tvayā ॥3-31-44॥

translations.english: He who has encouraged you in this is your enemy, indeed. He wants you to pluck out the fangs from the serpent's mouth.

verses.sloka: कर्मणा अनेन केन असि कापथम् प्रतिपादितः ।सुख सुप्तस्य ते राजन् प्रहृतम् केन मूर्धनि ॥३-३१-४५॥
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā anena kena asi kāpatham pratipāditaḥ ।sukha suptasya te rājan prahṛtam kena mūrdhani ॥3-31-45॥

translations.english: By whose action have you been led into this wrong direction? Who has hit you on your forehead while you were sleeping comfortably?

verses.sloka: विशुद्ध वंश अभिजना अग्र हस्तःतेजो मदः संस्थित दोर्??? विषाणः ।उदीक्षितुम् रावण न इह युक्तःस संयुगे राघव गन्धि हस्ती ॥३-३१-४६॥
verses.transliteration: viśuddha vaṁśa abhijanā agra hastaḥtejo madaḥ saṁsthita dor??? viṣāṇaḥ ।udīkṣitum rāvaṇa na iha yuktaḥsa saṁyuge rāghava gandhi hastī ॥3-31-46॥

translations.english: Rama is like a mighty tusker. His pure and high birth is his trunk. His wellbuilt and strong arms are his tusks. His brilliance in his ichor. Nobody can face this intoxicated elephant in battle.

verses.sloka: असौ रण अन्तः स्थिति संधि वालःविदग्ध रक्षो मृग हा नृसिंहः ।सुप्तः त्वया बोधयितुम् न शक्यःशारांग पुर्णो निशित असि दंष्ट्Rअः ॥३-३१-४७॥
verses.transliteration: asau raṇa antaḥ sthiti saṁdhi vālaḥvidagdha rakṣo mṛga hā nṛsiṁhaḥ ।suptaḥ tvayā bodhayitum na śakyaḥśārāṁga purṇo niśita asi daṁṣṭRaḥ ॥3-31-47॥

translations.english: Rama is a lion in the form of man, a lion on warfront with its tail touching the waist when angry. This lion is deft in killing deer in the form of clever demons. His body is full of arrows. The sharp swords are his pointed teeth. It does not behove you to rouse such a lion who is asleep.

verses.sloka: चापापहारे भुज वेग पंकेशर ऊर्मिमाले सु महा आहव ओघे ।न राम पाताल मुखे अति घोरेप्रस्कन्दितुम् राक्षस राज युक्तम् ॥३-३१-४८॥
verses.transliteration: cāpāpahāre bhuja vega paṁkeśara ūrmimāle su mahā āhava oghe ।na rāma pātāla mukhe ati ghorepraskanditum rākṣasa rāja yuktam ॥3-31-48॥

translations.english: O king of demons it is not proper (for you) to jump into the extremely fierce mouth of the nether world known as Rama. Who can steal the bow from his mighty arms which are whirlpools of mud. His arrows are rows of waves in the flow of the great war.

verses.sloka: प्रसीद लंकेश्वर राक्षसेन्द्रलंकाम् प्रसन्नो भव साधु गच्छ ।त्वम् स्वेषु दारेषु रमस्व नित्यम्रामः स भार्यो रमताम् वनेषु ॥३-३१-४९॥
verses.transliteration: prasīda laṁkeśvara rākṣasendralaṁkām prasanno bhava sādhu gaccha ।tvam sveṣu dāreṣu ramasva nityamrāmaḥ sa bhāryo ramatām vaneṣu ॥3-31-49॥

translations.english: O lord of Lanka, chief of the demons, be pleased to return to Lanka and enjoy yourself in the company of your wives. Let Rama enjoy with his wife in the forest.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तो दशग्रीवो मारीचेन स रावणः ।न्यवर्तत पुरीम् लंकाम् विवेश च गृह उत्तमम् ॥३-३१-५०॥
verses.transliteration: evam ukto daśagrīvo mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ ।nyavartata purīm laṁkām viveśa ca gṛha uttamam ॥3-31-50॥

translations.english: Thus advised by Maricha ,the ten headed Ravana returned and entered his best of homes in the city of Lanka . इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
